$comment: Seed catalogue (PRODUCTION_PLAN task 2.13). Source: AstraPlugins/examples/telegram-client/plugin.toml at version 0.1.0. `client` is one of the four capabilities the Phase 4 consent sheet gives its own checkbox; the summary and description here are written on the assumption that a user reads them before ticking it.
name: Telegram Bot
summary: Talk to Astra from Telegram: one forum topic per conversation, synced both ways.
description: Bridges a Telegram bot to Astra as a full chat client. /new creates a forum topic and a matching Astra conversation, /list links an existing one, and any message in a linked topic reaches Astra as if you had typed it in the app, with the reply streaming back as it is generated. Sync runs in both directions. Needs a bot token from @BotFather, a Telegram group with Topics enabled and the bot as an administrator, and outbound access to api.telegram.org. Read this part twice: installing it means your Astra conversations are relayed to Telegram, and leaving the allowed-usernames setting empty means anyone who can reach the bot can talk to your Astra.
